title: Relative Verdier duality and direct-image exchange over an arbitrary field
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the completed, rationalized, common-finite-stage categories $\mathcal C_T=D^b_c(T,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] and the compact-support functors of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. For $T=X,Y$, write $a_T:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. The functor $Ra_{T!}$ has a right adjoint $Ra_T^!$ on these constructible categories. Put $\omega_T=Ra_T^!\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,k}$ and $D_T=R\mathcal Hom(-,\omega_T)$, using the internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The normalization is the relative dimension function $t\mapsto\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(t)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree, def-weil-residue-field], and the dualizing object at $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the coefficient unit. Then $D_T:\mathcal C_T^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C_T$ is an exact anti-equivalence, with the evaluation-defined isomorphism $K\xrightarrow{\sim}D_TD_TK$ and $D_T(K[n])\cong D_T(K)[-n]$. The functors $Rf_!$ and $Rf_*$ take bounded constructible objects to bounded constructible objects, and the canonical map
$$D_YRf_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*D_XK$$
is an isomorphism for every $K\in\mathcal C_X$, natural in $K$ and compatible with shifts and finite coefficient-field extension. Here $Rf_*$ is the adic direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image].
